name: Add script triggers
description: Add script triggers Adds event trigger declarations without removing existing declarations owned by the script. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/triggers/{script_name}

name: Delete script triggers
description: Delete script triggers Deletes all event trigger declarations owned by a Worker script. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/triggers/{script_name}

name: Get script triggers
description: Get script triggers Returns the event trigger declarations owned by a Worker script. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/triggers/{script_name}

name: Replace script triggers
description: Replace script triggers Replaces all event trigger declarations owned by a Worker script. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/triggers/{script_name}
